Q00068_SagaOfTheSoulHound/1-01.htm.text: Head Blacksmith Noel: What brings you to me? All the orders are backed up; it's chaos!

links.text: "I've come to get the key Mona requested."

Q00068_SagaOfTheSoulHound/1-03.htm.text: Head Blacksmith Noel: Have you brought the Ice Crystals? Then hurry up and give them to me! Time's a-wastin'!

Q00068_SagaOfTheSoulHound/1-04.htm.text: Head Blacksmith Noel: Now, take that key to Mona.

Q00068_SagaOfTheSoulHound/1-05.htm.text: Head Blacksmith Noel: Hmmm... that could be problematic. You see, I have just run out of my spare keys... If you would like me to make you a key from scratch, I will need Ice Crystals from Chef Jeremy of the Hot Springs area. Why don't you go and talk to him?

Q00068_SagaOfTheSoulHound/1-06.htm.text: Head Blacksmith Noel: Wait right there. ... Here you go! Here's the key -- now take it to Mona.

Q00241_PossessorOfAPreciousSoul1/31272-0.text: Head Blacksmith Noel: Not just anybody can restore weapons of the old Empire, what makes you think you can help me? I can't even entrust Hilda or Feynn with the job! Well, Caradine does think highly of you.

Head Blacksmith Noel: OK, I'll give you the job. We need about five units of Lunargent, and a bottle of Hellfire Oil. Meet Magic Trader Wesley in the Ivory Tower. He'll tell you where to find them, or maybe you could get them from other Adventurers.
Head Blacksmith Noel: That took a while, but you did it. I have something to tell you.
Head Blacksmith Noel: You came back empty-handed? Hurry up and get five units of Lunargent and a bottle of Hellfire Oil!
Head Blacksmith Noel: Caradine wants to see you as soon as possible. You should go now.
Head Blacksmith Noel: Didn't I tell you? Caradine was urgently looking for you. Hurry up and go see her!
